name: Peru
overview:
It wouldn’t surprise us if more people have heard of Machu Picchu than Peru itself. The Inca citadel captures most of one’s imagination about the country. And once you see it, you understand why. 

While Machu Picchu is the main event, the other acts in the Peruvian show have their own charms. Not to mention a cuisine that’s often cited as the continent’s finest. 

So pack up for an Andean adventure that criss crosses centuries!
